questions.question_text: Which of the following statement is/are correct?
questions.question_html: Which of the following statement is/are correct?

A.text: A.Capacity miss can be reduced by the increasing the cache size.
A.html: Capacity miss can be reduced by the increasing the cache size.

B.text: B.The search concept used in associative memory in parallel search.
B.html: The search concept used in associative memory in parallel search.

C.text: C.Conflict miss can be reduced by the increasing cache size.
C.html: Conflict miss can be reduced by the increasing cache size.

D.text: D.Reducing block size will impact the spatial locality.
D.html: Reducing block size will impact the spatial locality.

questions.solution_text:
Solution
(a, b, d)
(a) True: Larger cache lines reduce capacity misses by improving spatial locality.
(b) True: Associative memory suitable for parallel searches and in used where search time needs to be minimized.
(c) False: Conflict misses in fact will increases by increasing block size because there will less number of lines.
(d) True
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(a, b, d)
(a) True: Larger cache lines reduce capacity misses by improving spatial locality.
(b) True: Associative memory suitable for parallel searches and in used where search time needs to be minimized.
(c) False: Conflict misses in fact will increases by increasing block size because there will less number of lines.
(d) True

questions.question_text:
Consider the following statements:
S
1
: Delay control transfer involve starting the execution of the instruction after a branch or control instruction regardless of whether the branch is taken.
S
2
: A way to implement branch prediction is to store the result of a branch condition in a branch target buffer.
S
3
: If, a multi-cycle, pipelined processor has ‘N’ pipeline stages, then structural hazards can be avoided completely if at least ‘N’ registers are available.
Which of the above statements are true?
questions.question_html:
Consider the following statements:
S1 : Delay control transfer involve starting the execution of the instruction after a branch or control instruction regardless of whether the branch is taken.
S2 : A way to implement branch prediction is to store the result of a branch condition in a branch target buffer.
S3 : If, a multi-cycle, pipelined processor has ‘N’ pipeline stages, then structural hazards can be avoided completely if at least ‘N’ registers are available.
Which of the above statements are true?
questions.solution_text:
Solution
(b)
S
1
: Delay control transfer is also known as delayed branching, is an attempt to code with control hazards.
In this technique, compiler rearrange the code to preserve the execution path. So, fetched of instruction after branch instruction (after rearrangement) will not hamper the execution of the program.
S
2
: The branch target stores the previous target address for the current branch. Other algorithm for branch prediction also exists.
S
3
: For any given instruction set architecture implemented on a N-stage pipelined processors, N registers probably is not enough registers to completely prevent structural hazards involving a shortage of register hardware.
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(b)
S1 : Delay control transfer is also known as delayed branching, is an attempt to code with control hazards.
In this technique, compiler rearrange the code to preserve the execution path. So, fetched of instruction after branch instruction (after rearrangement) will not hamper the execution of the program.
S2 : The branch target stores the previous target address for the current branch. Other algorithm for branch prediction also exists.
S3 : For any given instruction set architecture implemented on a N-stage pipelined processors, N registers probably is not enough registers to completely prevent structural hazards involving a shortage of register hardware.

questions.question_html:
Consider the following statements:

S2 : The main advantage of direct mapping is that the cache hit ratio increases drastically if two or more frequently used block map into same region.
Which of the following options is correct?
questions.solution_text:
Solution
(a)
S
1
: Since in direct mapped cache block can mapped to only a particular block by using formula [MM block % Cache blocks = Cache block number].
Where as in fully associative cache a block can mapped to more than one cache block with in a set so only fully associative cache needs cache replacement policy. So
S
1
is true.
S
2
: Main disadvantage of direct mapping is that cache hit ratio decreases sharply if two or more frequently used blocks map on to same region.
questions.solution_html:
Solution

(a)
S1 : Since in direct mapped cache block can mapped to only a particular block by using formula [MM block % Cache blocks = Cache block number].
Where as in fully associative cache a block can mapped to more than one cache block with in a set so only fully associative cache needs cache replacement policy. So S1 is true.
S2 : Main disadvantage of direct mapping is that cache hit ratio decreases sharply if two or more frequently used blocks map on to same region.
